description: Defines a router for AI Voice Agent API endpoints, including CRUD operations, testing, and setup functions, with dynamic imports for handlers.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing of voice agents, invokes listHandler.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific voice agent, invokes getHandler.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new voice agent, invokes createHandler.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing voice agent, invokes updateHandler.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a voice agent, invokes deleteHandler.

methods.name: testCall
methods.description: Performs a test call, invokes testCallHandler.

methods.name: createWebCall
methods.description: Creates a web call, invokes createWebCallHandler.

methods.name: setupInboundAgent
methods.description: Sets up inbound agent, invokes setupInboundAgentHandler.

methods.name: updateInboundAgentEventType
methods.description: Updates inbound agent event type, invokes updateInboundAgentEventTypeHandler.
